# udoma_revenue_type (Resource)

Resource represents a revenue type used for categorizing income on accounts.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the revenue type.
- `scope` (String) The scope where this revenue type is used.
- `system_default` (String) The system default category of this revenue type.

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description of the revenue type.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) The date and time the revenue type was created.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the revenue type.
- `is_catalog_item` (Boolean) Whether this entity is represented as a catalog item.
- `updated_at` (Number) The date and time the revenue type was last modified.
